Valid

Manage God Mode

Choose where you subscribed to view your billing or stop renewal.

Subscribed on the web

This includes Android subscriptions and payments made with Link, Apple Pay, or Google Pay on our website.

Open subscription settings

Sign in to the Valid account you used to subscribe. Your profile settings will open. Choose Unsubscribe from God Mode and complete the confirmation.

For payment details, or if you can't access your Valid account, open the billing portal using the email from your payment receipt. You can also cancel there.

Subscribed through the App Store

Open Apple subscriptions, choose Valid, and select Cancel Subscription. You can also open Settings on your iPhone, tap your name, then Subscriptions.

If your subscription doesn't appear, email support@validapp.lol with your Valid username and payment receipt.
